notes: Store-and-forward. Probe talks UHF to the 3U as baseline. 3U CubeSat is a separate Venus orbiter (never on the sphere). Rates are MarCO/Iris-class order-of-magnitude, scaled by Venus–Earth range. Conjunction blackout still applies.

architecture.baseline: UHF proximity (probe → 3U) then X-band DTE (3U → Earth)
architecture.descope: Carrier-provided relay or hybrid DTE if a partner flies a larger radio

cubesat.radio_class: Iris / MarCO X-band (~4 W RF) + UHF proximity

probe_to_relay.heritage: VEGA balloon-to-orbiter UHF; modern packet radio. Atmosphere at 55 km is radio-transparent at UHF.

relay_to_earth.heritage: MarCO Iris to DSN: ~1 kbps cruise typical, 8 kbps at Mars to a 70 m, 16 kbps when geometry allowed (DESCANSO 18).
relay_to_earth.ground: 34 m class (DSN or commercial equivalent). Pass time is a scheduling estimate.
relay_to_earth.conjunction_note: Superior conjunction: days to weeks of little or no X-band. Probe stores; CubeSat stores.

daily_return_mb.notes: MB/day ≈ rate_kbps × pass_min × 60 / 8 / 1000. Earth downlink is the bottleneck.

products.name: Met time-series (day)
products.notes: Fits in minutes even far from Earth.

products.name: AFN + TLS + MS science (day)
products.notes: Typical day of event-driven chemistry. Same-day at typical range.

products.notes: Sponsor / envelope / deck. Default public image product.
